key_insight_identified: Paper's key insight: Training-time evolution of the pushforward distribution through a drifting field that reaches equilibrium when distributions match. Student captured: no
novelty_alignment_rationale: The student proposes layer-wise evolution and force fields but misses the core mechanism of training-time pushforward evolution with anti-symmetric drifting fields.
novelty_gap: The paper's actual contribution is a drifting field V_p,q that governs sample movement during training iterations (not network layers), with anti-symmetry ensuring equilibrium when q=p. The student instead proposes evolution through network layers with force fields, missing the training-time evolution paradigm and the specific mathematical formulation of the drifting field.
strongest_aspect: Clear problem identification and well-structured presentation of ideas with good connections to existing work.
weakest_aspect: Completely misses the paper's core innovation of training-time pushforward evolution and instead proposes a different layer-wise evolution mechanism.
